title: Dynamics 365 Sales: Sales agent as the agentic home for sellers
summary: The briefing accurately separates the planned home experience from existing Sales agent capabilities and controls. The roadmap dates, documented navigation paths and surrounding licensing statements are supported; the home's default, dedicated controls and licensing remain unpublished.

claims.where: summary; What's changing; Why it matters; rationale: impact
claims.claim: Microsoft plans a Sales agent home that sellers can land in instead of a traditional dashboard when opening Dynamics 365 Sales.
claims.quote: When sellers open Dynamics 365 Sales, they can land in Sales agent: an agentic home for all sales AI instead of a traditional dashboard.

claims.claim: The planned home brings agent recommendations and customer-engagement preparation together through structured workflows.
claims.quote: Structured workflows in Sales agent bring agent recommendations and customer-engagement preparation together

claims.claim: Sellers can review prioritised recommendations and next steps from their agents in the planned home.
claims.quote: From this home, sellers can review prioritized recommendations and next steps from their agents

claims.claim: The roadmap includes preparation for upcoming customer meetings in the home.
claims.quote: prepare for upcoming customer meetings

claims.claim: The roadmap includes reviewing past meetings when the required meeting information is available.
claims.quote: review past meetings when the required meeting information is available.

claims.claim: The roadmap describes moving from an insight to the next action in a selling workflow.
claims.quote: Sellers can understand the context behind their work and move from an insight to the next action in their selling workflow.

claims.claim: The roadmap status is In development.
claims.quote: "status": "In development", "statusKey": "in-development"

claims.claim: Learn does not yet describe the agentic landing-home experience itself.

Opened use-sales-chat, set-up-sales-chat, install-sales-app and access-settings-apps; results describe chat or other agents, not this home.

claims.where: front matter: defaultState; summary; Why it matters; Governance guidance; Open questions; rationale: risk
claims.claim: Microsoft has not stated the new home's default state.
claims.quote: Searched: "Sales agent" "agentic home" default dashboard enable actions; "Sales agent" "home" "landing" Dynamics 365 Sales. Read the roadmap and use-sales-chat, install-sales-app, access-settings-apps; existing chat defaults do not state the new home's default.

claims.where: front matter: licensing.model and notes; Cost and licensing; Open questions; rationale: cost
claims.claim: The licensing model for the agentic home itself has not yet been published.
claims.quote: Searched: "Sales agent" "agentic home" licensing pricing Copilot Credits; "Sales agent" licensing billing consumption credits Dynamics 365 Sales. Opened buy-dynamics-365-sales and copilot-consumption-based-billing; read use-sales-chat. None specifies a licence for this home.

claims.where: controls[0]; summary; Governance controls; Open questions; rationale: risk
claims.claim: No dedicated UI or automation control is documented for choosing the new Sales agent home instead of the dashboard.
claims.quote: Searched: "Sales agent" "agentic home" default dashboard enable actions; "579978" Sales agent home; "Sales agent" "home" "landing" Dynamics 365 Sales. Opened access-settings-apps, set-up-sales-chat and add-microsoft-365-copilot; none documents a home/dashboard switch.

claims.claim: The existing Dynamics 365 access control is in Sales agent administrator settings > Tenant > Access settings > Allow access to Sales agent > Dynamics 365.
claims.quote: Under Tenant, select Access settings. ... Select Allow access to Sales agent. ... Dynamics 365: Allows access to the Sales agent in Microsoft 365 Copilot in Dynamics 365.

claims.claim: No API or PowerShell equivalent is documented for the Sales agent application access settings.
claims.quote: Searched: "Sales agent" "access settings" API PowerShell Dataverse configuration; "Sales agent" access settings PowerShell Microsoft Graph beta Dataverse API. Opened access-settings-apps and SalesAgentConfiguration references; none maps an API to these per-application access settings.

claims.claim: Tenant application access settings require Global Administrator, Exchange Administrator or Power Platform Administrator.
claims.quote: You must have one of the following Microsoft Entra roles: Global Administrator; Exchange Administrator; Power Platform Administrator

claims.claim: The application access control supports Microsoft Entra security-group restrictions.
claims.quote: For each, you can turn access on or off and use Microsoft Entra security groups to control who has access.

claims.where: controls[1-2].note; Why it matters; Risk assessment; Governance controls
claims.claim: Microsoft has not confirmed that existing Sales agent access and model-driven-app controls govern the new landing home.
claims.quote: Searched: "Sales agent" "agentic home" default dashboard enable actions; "Sales agent" "home" "landing" Dynamics 365 Sales. Opened access-settings-apps, set-up-sales-chat and add-microsoft-365-copilot; those document existing chat, not applicability to this home.

claims.where: controls[2].ui; Governance controls table; Governance guidance: Before rollout
claims.claim: The environment control is in Power Platform admin center > Copilot > Settings > Power Apps > Chat Agent > Microsoft Copilot > environment > Edit Setting.
claims.quote: go to Copilot > Settings. Under Power Apps, expand Chat Agent and choose Microsoft Copilot. ... Select an environment group or an environment name, then select Edit Setting.

claims.claim: No automation equivalent was found for the documented Microsoft Copilot environment control.
claims.quote: Searched: "Microsoft Copilot" "model-driven apps" environment enable PowerShell API pac admin setting; "Microsoft Copilot" "model-driven" "Power Platform API" "settings"; "Microsoft Copilot" "model-driven" "Set-AdminPowerAppEnvironment". Read add-microsoft-365-copilot; no equivalent found.

claims.where: controls[3].ui; Governance controls table; Governance guidance: Before rollout
claims.claim: CRM entities are added through Sales agent administrator settings > Features > Sales Chat > Add.
claims.quote: Open the Sales agent administrator settings. Under Features, select Sales Chat. Select Add.

claims.claim: No API or PowerShell equivalent was found for configuring the Sales Chat table list.
claims.quote: Searched: "Sales Chat" entities configuration Dataverse Web API Sales agent tables; "Sales Chat" "configuration" "Web API". Opened set-up-sales-chat and msdyn_salesagentconfiguration / msdyn_salesagentconfigurationv2 references; no operation is documented as configuring this table list.

claims.where: controls[3].note; Governance guidance: Before rollout; Governance controls
claims.claim: Dynamics 365 administrators can access the Sales agent environment settings with the System Administrator or System Customizer role.
claims.quote: Dynamics 365: You must have the System Administrator or System Customizer role.

claims.claim: Sales agent CRM settings apply to the CRM environment the administrator signs in to.
claims.quote: The settings apply to the CRM environment that you sign in to. To customize the Sales agent for a different environment, switch to that environment.

claims.claim: Learn describes the existing embedded Sales agent in Dynamics 365 as a preview capability.
claims.quote: The following capabilities are in preview: Sales agent is also accessible in Microsoft 365 Copilot within Outlook, Word, PowerPoint, Excel, and Dynamics 365.

claims.where: What's changing; controls[2].note; Scope; Risk assessment; Governance guidance; Governance controls
claims.claim: Existing Sales agent access in Dynamics 365 requires an administrator to enable Microsoft 365 Copilot in model-driven apps for the environment.
claims.quote: The Sales agent is available in Dynamics 365 only when Microsoft 365 Copilot is enabled for the environment and app module.

claims.claim: Microsoft 365 Copilot must also be enabled for the app module for existing Sales agent access in Dynamics 365.
claims.quote: An administrator must enable Microsoft 365 Copilot for the Dynamics 365 environment and app module.

claims.where: What's changing; Governance guidance: After rollout; Open questions
claims.claim: The current usage documentation says meeting preparation is not accessible in the embedded Dynamics 365 experience.
claims.quote: only conversational chat capabilities are available in these embedded experiences. Meeting preparation features aren't accessible in these locations.

claims.where: Why it matters; Risk assessment: Data exposure; controls[3].governs
claims.claim: Sales agent accesses CRM tables configured in its administrator settings.
claims.quote: The Sales agent accesses CRM information based on the CRM entities configured in Sales agent admin settings. In Dynamics 365, these entities are tables.

claims.where: Risk assessment: Data exposure; Governance guidance: Before rollout
claims.claim: Adding an entity to Sales Chat gives Sales agent access to all its columns, subject to the user permissions described elsewhere in the briefing.
claims.quote: Sales agent will have access to all columns in the added entities (tables in Dynamics 365 or objects in Salesforce).

claims.where: Why it matters; Risk assessment: Data exposure
claims.claim: Microsoft Graph-grounded context includes Outlook emails and Teams meetings.
claims.quote: Graph-grounded data (Outlook emails, Teams meetings, Teams messages, and People data stored in Microsoft Graph)

claims.where: Why it matters; Risk assessment: Data exposure; Cost and licensing; Governance guidance: Before rollout
claims.claim: Accessing Graph-grounded Sales agent data requires access to Microsoft 365 Copilot.
claims.quote: To access Graph-grounded data (Outlook emails, Teams meetings, Teams messages, and People data stored in Microsoft Graph), you must have access to Microsoft 365 Copilot.

claims.claim: Sales agent only surfaces information the user has permission to access.
claims.quote: Sales agent only surfaces information you have permission to access. Results depend on the data available in your Microsoft 365 environment.

claims.claim: Tenant access settings do not grant access to CRM data.
claims.quote: Tenant access settings don't grant access to CRM data

claims.claim: Tenant access settings do not override licensing, environment or security requirements.
claims.quote: Tenant access settings don't grant access to CRM data and don't override licensing, environment, or security requirements.

claims.where: Why it matters; Risk assessment: Security & identity
claims.claim: Assigned CRM security roles and privileges bound the CRM data a seller can access through existing Sales agent capabilities.
claims.quote: Users can access only the CRM environments, records, tables, and fields permitted by their assigned security roles and privileges.

claims.claim: Auto-installed users are blocked by default from Sales agent in Microsoft 365 Copilot.
claims.quote: Microsoft 365 Copilot | Auto-installed users are blocked. Other eligible users have access.

claims.claim: Auto-installed users are blocked by default from Sales agent in the Outlook sales pane.
claims.quote: Sales pane in Outlook | Auto-installed users are blocked. Other eligible users have access.

claims.claim: Auto-installed users are blocked by default from Sales agent in Teams.
claims.quote: Teams | Auto-installed users are blocked. Other eligible users have access.

claims.where: Risk assessment: Security & identity; Governance controls
claims.claim: The existing Dynamics 365 access setting allows all eligible users by default, with Microsoft 365 Copilot in Dynamics 365 also required to be turned on.
claims.quote: Dynamics 365 | All eligible users have access. Microsoft 365 Copilot in Dynamics 365 must also be turned on.

claims.claim: Users blocked by access settings see an administrator-disabled message in the enabled Dynamics 365 Sales agent experience.
claims.quote: Dynamics 365 | Sales agent remains available in Microsoft Copilot in Dynamics 365, if enabled, but displays an administrator-disabled message.

claims.claim: Sales agent uses Dataverse search to query Dynamics 365 CRM data.

claims.claim: Microsoft has not published the home's rollout mechanics or said that it replaces the dashboard for every seller.
claims.quote: Searched: "Sales agent" "agentic home" default dashboard enable actions; "Sales agent" "home" "landing" Dynamics 365 Sales. Read the roadmap's "can land" wording and opened install-sales-app and use-sales-chat; none specifies a universal dashboard replacement.

claims.claim: Microsoft has not specified the actions that can be taken from this new home.
claims.quote: Searched: "Sales agent" "agentic home" default dashboard enable actions; "Sales agent" "home" "landing" Dynamics 365 Sales. Read the roadmap and use-sales-chat; recommended-actions results describe a separate capability without establishing its integration into this home.

claims.claim: Microsoft has not specified whether actions from this new home write to CRM.
claims.quote: Searched: "Sales agent" "agentic home" default dashboard enable actions; "Sales agent" "home" "landing" Dynamics 365 Sales. Read roadmap, use-sales-chat and add-microsoft-365-copilot; existing chat and custom-agent capabilities do not establish this home's write behaviour.
